title: 第3章 杀人第4章 危机第5章 猎狼
lines: “滚出去！”
龙珍和楚河面色难看，楚欣在楚河怀里都快要挤出泪来，突然听到身后有一道凶横的怒吼。
见到楚生握住柴刀，楚河连忙按住他的手，低语道：“老二，别冲动，楚二柱身后应该就是王虎的人。”
“王虎可是城北区的地头蛇，我们惹不起。”
“母亲，大哥二哥，欣儿不要嫁人！”楚欣泪水流了出来，小手擦个不停。
“楚二柱，你不是说你能搞定吗？你就是这么搞定的？”一个满脸横肉的青年从楚二柱身后走向前，强健的肌肉裹满整条胳膊，一把将其推到一边，看着拿着柴刀的楚生，一脸嘲讽道：
“一个书生，也敢叫我滚？以后我王豪在城北怎么混？”
“现在，你给我跪下磕头赔罪，我还会给你聘礼钱。”
“快给豪哥跪下！跪下！”身后的四个手下兴奋地嚎叫起来。
楚二柱在身后，知道楚生不是对手，叫嚣道：“楚生，快给豪哥跪下，我求豪哥饶你一命！”
王豪内心得到极大的满足，得意地顿了顿道：“如若不然，不仅要带走你妹妹，还要带走你娘，而且还不给钱！哈哈哈！”
“哈哈哈！”
“哈哈哈！”
几人连番哄笑，显然不把楚生兄弟二人放在眼里。
而王豪身后的楚二柱却是抽了抽，额间已经全是汗水，心中满是后悔：
“早知道就该等大伯母一人在家过来，现在麻烦了。楚生也是一个狠人，要是大伯一家都被杀了，我该怎么向父亲交代？”
于是，楚二柱大喊道：“大伯母，堂哥堂弟，你们可不要冲动，你们不会是豪哥的对手！”
楚河感受到楚生战栗的手，抬头一看，只见其双目充血，怒火就要如同火山喷发。
这种状态，还是他和楚生上山捕猎，楚生独战野猪时才有的。
楚河狠狠压住想要举起的刀，声音低沉道：“老二，还能忍吗？”
一旁的龙珍看向两个已经长大的兄弟，既骄傲又痛苦，心生绝望：“夫君，我对不住你，没有照顾好我们的孩子。”
楚生看着绝望的母亲，忍耐的大哥，哭泣的妹妹，想起今日街上看到的一幕，摇摇头：
“大哥，王虎就是一个残忍的畜生，绝不能把小妹嫁给他，我们没得选了！”
“等下照顾好母亲和小妹，其他的交给我！”
“不行，我才是大哥，等下我来拦住他们，你带着母亲和妹妹离开。”楚河想要夺取楚生手上的柴刀，却怎么都掰不开，然后妥协道：“好，注意安全。”
楚生提刀上前，楚河则是牵着母亲和妹妹的手，进入了房屋中，拿上菜刀走出，然后守在门口。
屋内的楚欣低声问道：“母亲，大哥二哥会没事吧！”
“欣儿乖，会没事的。”龙珍通过缝隙望着两个儿子，双手紧紧抱着怀里的女儿，眼神里尽是死志，显然做好了宁死不屈的准备。
王豪笑容停滞，面容扭曲起来，阴沉道：“既然给脸不要脸，那就让你们见识见识我王豪的手段！”
“兄弟们，给我拿下他们二人，我要折磨死他们！”
说罢便是抽出腰间砍刀，比楚生的柴刀长了不少。
其他四人也是一同拿出兵器，跨步而出。
楚生面不改色，按照这些年对面板的研究与验证，他清楚对方的底细。
正常成年男性气血值也就10左右，而眼前的王豪，顶天也就12。
而自己的气血值，此刻是20，为了安全起见，楚生意念一动，杀戮值瞬间清零。
content_en:
"Get out!"
Long Zhen and Chu He looked ugly. Chu Xin was about to burst into tears in Chu He's arms when she suddenly heard a fierce roar behind her.
Seeing Chu Sheng holding the hatchet, Chu He quickly held his hand and whispered: "Second brother, don't be impulsive. Behind Chu Erzhu should be Wang Hu's person."
"Wang Hu is a local snake in the northern part of the city, we can't afford to offend him."
"Mom, eldest brother and second brother, Xin'er doesn't want to get married!" Chu Xin burst into tears and kept wiping her hands.
"Chu Erzhu, didn't you say you could handle it? Is this how you did it?" A young man with a sinewy face came forward from behind Chu Erzhu, his strong muscles wrapped around his entire arm. He pushed it aside and looked at Chu Sheng who was holding a hatchet, mockingly saying:
"How dare a scholar tell me to get lost? How will I, Wang Hao, get around in the north of the city from now on?"
"Now, if you kneel down and kowtow to me to apologize, I will also give you the betrothal gift."
"Kneel down for Brother Hao! Kneel down!" The four men behind him howled excitedly.
Chu Erzhu was behind him, knowing that Chu Sheng was no match, so he shouted: "Chu Sheng, kneel down to Brother Hao quickly, I beg Brother Hao to spare your life!"
Wang Hao felt extremely satisfied in his heart and paused proudly: "If not, not only will I take away your sister, but I will also take away your mother, and I won't pay any money! Hahaha!"
"Hahaha!"
"Hahaha!"
Several people laughed repeatedly, obviously not taking the Chu Sheng brothers seriously.
But Chu Erzhu behind Wang Hao was twitching, his forehead was covered with sweat, and his heart was filled with regret:
"If I had known, I would have waited for my eldest aunt to come home alone, but now I am in trouble. Chu Sheng is also a ruthless person. If my aunt and his family are all killed, how should I explain to my father?"
So, Chu Erzhu shouted: "Auntie, cousin, please don't be impulsive, you will not be Brother Hao's opponent!"
Chu He felt Chu Sheng's trembling hands and looked up, only to see that his eyes were bloodshot and his anger was about to erupt like a volcano.
This state was only experienced when he and Chu Sheng went to the mountains to hunt and Chu Sheng fought wild boars alone.
Chu He firmly suppressed the knife he wanted to raise, and said in a low voice: "Second brother, can you still bear it?"
Long Zhen, who was standing aside, looked at her two grown-up brothers, feeling both proud and painful, feeling desperate: "Husband, I can't help you for not taking good care of our children."
Chu Sheng looked at his desperate mother, his patient elder brother, and his crying sister. Thinking of the scene he saw on the street today, he shook his head:
"Brother, Wang Hu is a cruel beast. We must not marry my little sister to him. We have no choice!"
"Take care of mother and little sister later, and leave the rest to me!"
"No, I'm the eldest brother. I'll stop them later, and you take your mother and sister away." Chu He wanted to take the hatchet from Chu Sheng's hand, but couldn't break it open. Then he compromised and said, "Okay, pay attention to safety."
Chu Sheng stepped forward with the knife, while Chu He held the hands of his mother and sister, entered the house, took the kitchen knife and walked out, then guarded the door.
Chu Xin in the room asked in a low voice: "Mom, will the eldest and second brothers be okay?"
"Xin'er, be good, everything will be fine." Long Zhen looked at her two sons through the gap, holding her daughter tightly in her arms with both hands, her eyes filled with the will to die, and she was obviously ready to die rather than surrender.
Wang Hao's smile stopped, his face became distorted, and he said gloomily: "Since I am shameless, let you see what I, Wang Hao, can do!"
"Brothers, capture these two for me, I will torture them to death!"
After saying that, he took out the machete from his waist, which was much longer than Chu Sheng's hatchet.
The other four people also took out their weapons and stepped out.
Chu Sheng's expression remained unchanged. According to the research and verification of the panel over the years, he knew the details of the other party.
A normal adult male's qi and blood value is only about 10, but the Wang Hao in front of him has a qi and blood value of 12.
As for his health value, it was 20 at the moment. For the sake of safety, Chu Shang had a thought and the killing value was instantly cleared.
[Qi and blood: 23.7]
